title: Karbala ki ye sada hai lailaha illallah
body:
KARBALA KI YE SADA HAI LAILAHA ILLALLA
Chin Gayi Zainab Ki Chadar Lutgaya Zehra Ka Ghar
Tab Kahin Jaker Basa Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Jiski Qatir Hogaye Abbas Ke Bazu Qalam
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Tarha Ye Chagaya Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Reg Zare Karbala Per Cheh Mahine Ka Ali
Teer Khaker Kheraha Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Deene Ahmed Ka Muarriq Hai Hussain Ibne Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Jisne Khoon Se Likh diya Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Deen Per Mohre Nabuwat Sajda-e- Shabbir Hai
Naksh Dil Par Ho Gaya Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Chadar-e- Tathir Kehti Thi Sina Ke Nok Par
<<DIVIDER>>
Meri Zainab Ki Rida Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Ye Hussain Ibne Ali Ki Khoon Ki Taseer Hai
Har Musalla Padh Raha Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
Baat Ye Syed-e-mazhar Ek Zuban Hoker Kahe
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah Ke Matam Ki Sada Hai LAILAHA ILLALLA
